Product Overview

Simplify your trailer wiring installation on your 1986-1992 Ford Ranger with this plug-and-play T-Connector trailer wire harness. Featuring a standard 4-way flat output, this harness provides a clean, reliable connection for your trailer lights without the need for cutting or splicing into your vehicle's factory wiring.

Features

  • 4-way flat output connector for universal trailer light compatibility
  • Plug-and-play T-Connector design eliminates cutting and splicing
  • Direct fit for 1986-1992 Ford Ranger models
  • Provides reliable signal for turn, brake, and running lights
  • Quick and easy installation with no special tools required
  • Weatherproof construction for long-lasting durability

Vehicle Fitment

  • 1986-1992 Ford Ranger

Specifications

  • MPN: 55314
  • Connector Type: 4-Way Flat Output
  • Connection Style: T-Connector
  • Part Number: THW-RANG86-4W-EF314
